message: Ignition EULA has not been accepted on this machine (Consent record: <HOME>/.config/igdev/accepted.toml)

remediation.why: a person must accept Ignition EULA once per machine: the Gateway image refuses to start without it (agents may never accept on a human's behalf, ADR 0004)
or a person sets it once in this environment's configuration (a cloud environment, a CI secret, a shell profile); agents never set it themselves
